result:
If I could change the world in one way, I’d make it easier for people to truly understand one another—across differences in culture, belief, experience, and background.

So much conflict and harm seem to come not from lack of intelligence or resources, but from fear, misunderstanding, and an inability to see the humanity in others. If empathy were stronger and more immediate, many other problems—inequality, cruelty, polarization, neglect—would become easier to solve.
